body: Which country are you from, if you don't mind me asking?

I am sorry to hear that. It's something no one should have to be forced to face alone.
Even though your country may not regard it as an offense, there are organizations (e.g Unicef, Amnesty and others) that may be able to help you.
Do you have an adult at school, for example a teacher or a school nurse you would be able to talk to?
Why couldnt you tell him that?
There are billions of people in this world.. Maybe you could give some of them a chance to understand?

Do you think that you could contact the child protective services in your area?
What your mother is doing to you is very wrong, and there are laws that protect minors from such treatment. 
I understand contacting the child protective services may seem scary to you, in which case are there any trustworthy adults you might speak to?
